resources.string: Use this when the host has created a one-time PIN for this device. Enter the four-digit PIN and its passphrase. The PIN works for three minutes.
Enter the four-digit PIN from the host.
Enter the passphrase you chose on the host (at least four characters).

1. Start Butterpollo on your PC. This device must be on the same network.

2. Your PC appears here. If it doesn't, tap + and enter its IP address.

3. Tap the PC to pair. This app shows a PIN: enter it in the host's web console under Devices.

Got a one-time PIN from the host? Long-press the PC and choose Pair with one-time PIN. Long-press also opens per-PC settings and details.
